modmenu.summaryTranslation.emberflow: More FPS with shaders on Vulkan, especially with lots of mobs.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.emberflow:
More FPS with shaders on Vulkan.

§6✦ §fFaster mobs§7, only the data the shader pack really reads
§e☀ §fFaster mob shadows§7, each mob is prepared once per frame
§a⚡ §fDynamic resolution§7, holds your target FPS with Vitrail
§b⚙ §fEverything adjustable§7 in the video settings

§8Made for Minecraft's Vulkan renderer and Vitrail. The image stays the same.
emberflow.notice.not_vulkan: The game is running on %s, not Vulkan. Emberflow only speeds up the Vulkan renderer and does nothing here. Switch to Vulkan in the video settings and restart Minecraft.
emberflow.notice.switch_question:
Emberflow cannot run on %s, it only speeds up the Vulkan renderer. Would you like to switch to Vulkan?
This closes the game, just start it again afterwards.
emberflow.option.fast_entity_data.toolti: Leaves out mob data the active shader pack does not read. Checks the pack itself.
emberflow.option.reuse_entity_states.too: Uses a mob's state from the same frame for its shadow too.
emberflow.option.fast_vertex_lookup.tool: Remembers how mob vertices are converted instead of looking it up again for every box.
emberflow.option.pause_menu_fps.tooltip: FPS limit in the pause menu. 0 or far left = no limit.
emberflow.option.adaptive_scale.tooltip: Lowers the world resolution when FPS drop below the target. Needs Vitrail and a shader pack.
emberflow.option.adaptive_target_fps.too: Below this the resolution is lowered. This is not an FPS limit.
emberflow.option.adaptive_min_scale.tool: It never goes lower than this.
emberflow.option.game_monitor.tooltip: 1 = main monitor, 2 = second monitor. Takes effect on the next start.
